experiment.continue_gate: all six runs valid; blend mean score >= control mean - 2.0; no new failure on critical safety scenarios passed by control; and either median E2E of paired correct tasks improves >=15% or output tokens on those same tasks decrease >=20%. A pass only authorizes a larger holdout, never production adoption.
host_preflight: check lock token; candidate and control hashes; exact repo/runtime/template/suite hashes; destination free space >=25 GiB; inference-server scan; port 18104 free; inspect both GPU compute processes, free VRAM and temperatures; preserve GUI; no external server or conflicting model test.
experiment.resource_policy: No memory cgroup limits or system RAM/swap caps. Observe MemAvailable/PSI/swap/OOM. Stop only on OOM/CUDA allocation error, server loss, host MemAvailable below 2 GiB for two consecutive samples, or either RTX 3090 >=85 C. Never touch ASTRA/SOL/production or PeritoSoft.
